lessons.keep: Show a real-looking source item flowing into one command and visible result.
lessons.avoid: Showing a success state without enough of the preceding user decision to understand the action.
lessons.open: Transaction reality, wallet setup, result accuracy, final outdoor task and audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, move one customer insight from a source card into a campaign command and output.
Add a readable amount and approval frame before the purchase status, then highlight one table row.

comparison.story: Set up quick access to a token opportunity. → Show a short command-to-result chain. → Name the product and broaden its functions. → Show question-based research alongside commands. → Summarize the promise and provide installation action. → Reinforce access from varied contexts and end on brand.
